_README: Waiver ledger for tools/gate_mastery_ui.py. Round-2 reflow (feat/mastery-ui-vet) CLEARED every CONNECTOR-LAW defect Will reported (0 unwaived CONN/INTERLEAVE/OFFCOL across all 9 masteries) via tools/patches/mastery_ui_vet.py (non-golden 1/2/4/7/8/9) + tools/patches/hunting_occult_ui.py (golden Occult 5 + Hunting 6). The keys below are the ONLY residual findings; each is an IRREDUCIBLE tier collision / graft-broken skillTier / missing-record phantom that has no law-compliant placement on the fixed 6-column x 7-row grid, with a one-sentence reason. A NEW or regressed finding is NOT here so it fails the build. Golden (m5/m6) fields ALSO carry owner_approved_overrides in occult_hunting_golden.json. Full analysis: docs/reports/mastery_ui_reflow_round2.md.

waivers.TIER::m1::drx_clubslam: Graft-broken skillTier: Club Slam is tier2 but its SOLE modifier (drx_clubslam_fissure) is tier7 - a 5-tier gap. Keeping the base connected to its modifier (arrows-correct, Will's primary law) forces them adjacent at rows 1-2; placing both tier-correct (rows 2 and 7) would monopolize col3 and displace the intact Battle Standard family. No layout satisfies both the CONNECTOR LAW and row==skillTier here.
waivers.TIER::m1::drx_clubslam_fissure: Graft-broken skillTier (tier7): the sole modifier of the tier2 Club Slam base; must sit directly above its base for the connector to read, so it lands at row2 not row7. Same irreducible base-tier2/mod-tier7 conflict as drx_clubslam.
waivers.TIER::m1::drxhamstring: Graft standalone (tier4, no modifier, no connector): a duplicate of the real Onslaught Hamstring modifier. Every tier-4 cell in Warfare is a family base or inside a family Y-span, so no tier-correct span-free cell exists; parked at the col3 divider row (row6) span-free. Candidate for deletion (Will's data call: is it a redundant graft?).
waivers.TIER::m3::drxrupture: Earth col4 crams FOUR grafted families (Ring of Flame + Rupture chain + Spontaneous Combustion + Fire Nova) with tier collisions (rupture tier1 & ringofflame tier1 both want row1; flare tier5 & spontaneous tier5). Will's explicit 2026-07-13 ask was the b38 contiguous 'Rupture starts lower' packing; arrows are ALL correct and tiers are progression-sane (base low, mods stacking). No free Earth column exists for a tier-correct grafted-Rupture placement without displacing the intact Ring of Flame family.
waivers.TIER::m3::drxrupture_burning: Same Earth col4 4-family overcrowding as drxrupture: the b38 contiguous Rupture packing (Will's ask) keeps arrows correct but cannot also be row==skillTier given the tier collisions.
waivers.TIER::m3::drxringofflame_softenmetal: Same Earth col4 overcrowding: Soften Metal (tier3) sits at row2 directly above its Ring of Flame base so the connector reads; making it tier-correct (row3) would collide with the Rupture chain packed in the same column.
waivers.TIER::m3::drxspontaneouscombustion: Same Earth col4 overcrowding: Spontaneous Combustion (tier5) collides with Flame Arch (also tier5) in the packed column; one of the two must be off-tier. Arrows unaffected (it carries no connector).
waivers.TIER::m3::drx_firenova: Same Earth col4 overcrowding: Fire Nova (tier6) is pushed to row7 by the contiguous 7-skill packing (Will's b38 ask). No connector, so arrows are unaffected.
waivers.TIER::m4::drxstormnimbus_heartoffrost: Storm Nimbus has TWO tier-2 modifiers (Spell Breaker + Heart of Frost); only one fits col1 row2. Heart of Frost is reunited into its base column (was OFFCOL in col6) at row3 so the family stays contiguous and connected - no second tier-2 cell exists in one column.
waivers.TIER::m4::drxfrostnova: Graft standalone (tier6, no modifier): every tier-5/6 cell in Storm is inside a family span (Ice Shard / Lightning Bolt / Storm Wisp / Storm Nimbus / Spell Breaker). Placed at the top of the Squall column (row7) span-free so it reads as an advanced skill; no free tier-6 cell exists.
waivers.TIER::m4::drx_lightningdash: Graft standalone (tier5, no modifier): same Storm overcrowding as Frost Nova - no free tier-5 cell outside a family span. Placed at the top of the Spell Breaker column (row7) span-free.
waivers.ICON::m4::drxspellbreaker_spellshock2: SV-original DEAD reference: the skillName target records\skills\storm\drxspellbreaker_spellshock2.dbr never existed in any source, so the button is a phantom. No UI position or connector edit can validate a nonexistent skill. The clean fix (remove the button) is blocked by fix_mastery_panel_buttons' auto-discovery gap-break (deleting skill25.dbr would also drop the real skill26/27 buttons) and is a tree-structure change needing Will's delete-vs-repoint design decision + in-game sign-off. Its button IS moved out of the Storm Nimbus span so it no longer INTERLEAVEs (that finding is cleared).
waivers.OFFCOL::m4::drxspellbreaker_spellshock2: Same phantom dead-reference: its family root resolves to Spell Breaker (col4) but the button is in col1, and the skill record does not exist to reunite. Cleared only by removing the phantom button (Will's structural call, see the ICON waiver).
waivers.TIER::m5::drxlaytrap_petmodifier_multish: GOLDEN Occult: Lay Trap (base) and this pet-modifier are BOTH tier3; after reuniting the orphan into Lay Trap's column (it was OFFCOL in col1) only one tier-3 cell exists, so the modifier shifts to row4 to keep the family contiguous and connected. Also an owner_approved_overrides entry in occult_hunting_golden.json.
waivers.CONN::m5::drx_summon_shadow_stalker: GOLDEN Occult: the Shadow Stalker summon's bar reaches drx_petmodifier_greaterpower directly above it - a GENUINE summon->pet-upgrade augment - but the generic 'drx_petmodifier_greaterpower' name shares no prefix with 'drx_summon_shadow_stalker', so the '_'-prefix family detector cannot link them. Keeping the correct connection and waiving the detector false-positive is preferred over dropping a real augment link.
waivers.TIER::m7::drxlifedrain_cascade: Life Drain (base) and Life Drain Cascade are BOTH tier3; after reuniting Cascade into Life Drain's column (it was OFFCOL in col6) only one tier-3 cell exists, so Cascade shifts to row2 directly below its base (still reads as the pair). No second tier-3 cell exists in one column.
waivers.TIER::m7::drxsoulsiphontotem: Spirit is the most-crowded tree (9 families with a tier-1/2 base for 6 columns). Soul Siphon Totem (tier2) has no free tier-2 cell - every tier-2 cell is a family base or inside a family Y-span - so it is parked at a span-free row5 cell in col4. A single (no connector), so arrows are unaffected.
